heading: Proof of rent arrears
paragraphs: As your claim is on the grounds of rent arrears, you must now answer questions about:
bullets: how much the arrears were on the date you served notice, if you served notice
how much the rent arrears are on today’s date
how much the rent is and how frequently it should be paid

contentBlocks.text: You must also provide proof of how the rent arrears have built up over time. You can either:

bullets: upload a rent statement that follows specific guidelines

contentBlocks.text: The defendant will be able to see your answers and any documents you upload.
